Game Overview

In Stick Hero Tower Defense, the core idea is straightforward: join the valiant stickman in a thrilling mix of action and strategy. Master drag-and-drop combat, outsmart enemies with clever tactics, and gather allies to boost your power. Face epic battles with monstrous bosses to emerge victorious in this captivating tower defense experience.
